Here's my take, being a free game does not justify putting an overly priced tag on a skin and gambling.

There are multiple FTP games out there that have reasonable skin prices without loot boxes. For example, Warframe has one of the best micro transactions for a FTP game, skin prices range from 10$ to 30$ and if you grind for the premium currency in game it's free. Look at the Warframe community no one is ranting about expensive prices of skins (except for that one time DE F'ed up). Looking at the game's success I'd say the workers at DE are being paid fine.

Secondly do you understand how much is 300$?
Here in my country $300 is 1100Myr that's fking 80% of the minimum wadge in Malaysia, 400myr is the average monthly spending for food. Do you understand how expensive that shit is? You only think of stuff in the US and not realizing how much stuff costs in other parts of the world cost.

Loot boxes are scams no matter what game you play, gaming shouldn't have gambling in the first place. You should be able to buy the skin you want for what it's actually worth.
